definitions.full: H8355. shethah [ שְׁתָה ] verb drink ( אִשְׁתִּי שְׁתָא, ᵑ7 , Syriac ; see Biblical Hebrew I. שָׁתָה ); — Pe`al Perfect 3masculine plural אִשְׁתִּיו (K § 11, 4 , a )) Dan 5:3-4 , Imperfect 3masculine plural יִשְׁתּוֺן 5:2 ; Participle active שָׁתֵה 5:1 , plural שָׁתַ֫יִן ; — drink , accusative wine 5:1 , 4 , + ב of vessel 5:23 and (accusative omitted) 5:2 ; 5:3 .
